purpose: prove that the runner's exit code carries the verdict (a bookkeeping-only rc=0 is impossible) and that the frozen oracle is reproducible

cases.proves: a corrupted expectation is no longer hidden behind a bookkeeping-only rc=0; the product itself still returned the correct value

cases.mutation: oracle.json positive.expected_float -> my own deliberately wrong hand value (scratch copy only)
cases.proves: a wrong hand computation is also caught; the frozen value is load-bearing

cases.mutation: none: the frozen values are used again in the same scratch tree
cases.proves: the repaired exit code still returns 0 for a genuinely passing card

cases.mutation: NEG-CARD's mutation replaced in memory by the identity value via --case-override
cases.proves: an unrejected negative really turns the verdict red (FAIL_not_rejected)

cases.mutation: none: re-run the SAME oracle generator with --out-root pointed at a scratch tree
cases.proves: the frozen expected values are reproducible from the generator alone, and the scratch regeneration did not write to the frozen evidence directory

exit_code_map.0: positive within the frozen tolerance AND continuity positive ok AND all negatives rejected
exit_code_map.1: an unguarded harness defect raised (fail loud)
exit_code_map.2: no verdict could be produced (for example the positive input itself is broken)
exit_code_map.3: the verdict is negative (positive mismatch, continuity failure, or an unrejected negative)
